headline: Gemini Spark automates Mac tasks remotely from your phone
summary: Google's AI assistant expands to macOS, automates tasks, and integrates with more apps
details: Google's Gemini Spark AI assistant now automates tasks on Mac, even when you're not looking. It can organize files, create spreadsheets, and more.
The feature is part of the Gemini app for macOS, which was launched a couple of months ago. Spark's capabilities are currently limited to AI Ultra subscribers in the US.
Gemini Spark also integrates with Google Tasks, Keep, Canva, Dropbox, Instacart, and Zillow Rentals, allowing for more complex tasks like designing custom flyers or ordering groceries.
The AI agent can track specified topics and react to them in real-time, such as providing financial reports or sports updates.
caption:
Can an AI assistant automate tasks on your Mac? Gemini Spark says yes!

Google's Gemini Spark AI assistant now automates tasks on Mac, even when you're not looking. It can organize files, create spreadsheets, and more.

The feature is part of the Gemini app for macOS, which was launched a couple of months ago. Spark's capabilities are currently limited to AI Ultra subscribers in the US.

Gemini Spark also integrates with Google Tasks, Keep, Canva, Dropbox, Instacart, and Zillow Rentals, allowing for more complex tasks like designing custom flyers or ordering groceries.

The AI agent can track specified topics and react to them in real-time, such as providing financial reports or sports updates.

#AI #Google #Gemini #Automation

Source: Android Police, TechCrunch, Engadget, 9to5Mac
